name: Marguerite S. Lopez-Sapien
office: City of Irwindale, Member of the City Council

items.text: In a 2024 questionnaire, Marguerite S. Lopez-Sapien said she was a healthcare worker and had served as an Irwindale Parks and Recreation commissioner for 12 years.
